description: This Java class 'HiveMqtt5ClientActor' manages MQTT 5 protocol connections within an Akka actor framework. It extends an abstract MQTT client actor and provides methods for creating actor props, managing connections, and spawning publisher and consumer actors tailored for HiveMQ's MQTT 5 client.

classes.name: HiveMqtt5ClientActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class that manages MQTT 5 client connections and interactions, including creating publishers and consumers, handling connection lifecycle, and integrating with HiveMQ's MQTT client library.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory methods to create Props instances for actor creation, with parameters for connection, proxy actor, client factory, and connection actor.

methods.name: createSubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Creates a subscription handler for MQTT subscriptions, returning a HiveMqtt5SubscriptionHandler instance.

methods.name: sendConn
methods.description: Initiates MQTT connection with specified clean session setting.

methods.name: startPublisherActor
methods.description: Starts a publisher actor for MQTT message publishing.

methods.name: startConsumerActor
methods.description: Starts a consumer actor for MQTT message subscription and processing.
